observations: Photo 0 shows the retail packaging for a Singer sewing machine.
The brand 'SINGER' and model 'HD4432 Heavy Duty' are clearly printed on the box.
The box indicates 110 stitch applications and 11 accessories included.
The actual sewing machine is not visible; only the illustration on the box is shown.
A watermark 'SEW LEGACY' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible on the image.

claims.evidence: The box does not specify the material compatibility.
The box lists 110 stitch applications, but the full range of stitches is not shown.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, lower-value item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual machine outside of the box.

risks.risk: The machine may be used, refurbished, or have internal mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video of the machine powered on and running through its stitch selection.

risks.risk: Essential accessories like the foot pedal or power cord may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual sewing machine outside of the box.
Photo of the machine's serial number plate.
Video of the machine powered on and stitching a test piece.
Photo of the foot pedal and power cord.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
